title: A resource theoretical unification of Mpemba effects: classical and quantum

split.decision: 用户决定：隐藏(J,h,beta_initial,Ns)实例，60分钟预算。公开train 6，val为原Fig.2实例与5个公开seed实例；隐藏独立secrets实例。Ns均匀{6,7,8}, J~U(-.5,-.3), h~U(.1,.3), beta_initial~U(.4,.6), bath beta=1。每实例10个优化种子取median(log10 C)，再对实例等权平均；生成seed仅存operator记录。

baseline.paper_ref: Fig.2 C approximately 2e-5; fixed-instance reproduction median(log10 C)=-4.111205723730961

allowed_changes: Permutation search, proposals, optimizer, annealing schedule, iteration count, numerical surrogate and implementation.
Development-selected configuration/reusable policy solving each instance independently; simulated annealing is a baseline.
When retaining the supplied simulated annealer, changing only iterations=50000, the four-entry proposal size or temperature=max(1e-5,0.02*(1-step/iterations)) does not count as a method improvement.
fixed_contract: Minimize fixed two-slow-mode overlap by permuting each supplied Gibbs vector, preserving independent-replica median-log aggregation.
Supplied p, equilibrium pi and two normalized slow modes of the same Ising instance; Eq. (13), K=2.
Feasible outputs are permutations of the original probability multiset, including degeneracies.
Ten independent runs per instance, median of log10 costs followed by instance mean, original outer-seed and isolation protocol.
Supplied data/splits, evaluation metric, trusted evaluator and lawful information access.
method_freedom_review.budget_policy: agent overall deadline; separate overall formal replay budget
forbidden_substitutions: Change probability vectors, Hamiltonian-derived modes, overlap target or permutation feasible set.
Return arbitrary distributions, alter median/log ordering, or share/select best solutions across required independent replicas.
Use private metadata, precomputed permutations or another evaluation instance.
Training or fitting reusable model state or learned preprocessing on validation features or labels, including final train+val refits or validation-based distillation.
